newsitem.title: GERMANY: Plettac sees 1996 profit of 95-100 mln DM.
newsitem.headline: Plettac sees 1996 profit of 95-100 mln DM.

text.p: German scaffolding maker Plettac AG said on Tuesday that it would post net profits in line with its target this year of 95 million to 100 million marks on turnover of 970 million marks.

The company said in a regulatory news release it had overcome poor business conditions caused by bad weather earlier this year, and all of its business areas would make a positive contribution to profits.
Turnover is expected to rise to 1.06 billion marks next year. Plettac said it would seek to keep a steady return on sales of around 10 percent and maintain an investor-friendly dividend policy.
